title: Catalog tiles & pricing visuals for release notes and quickstart
creator: Marin Li
description: Create a focused set of UX assets for the upcoming catalog release notes and onboarding quickstart: hero tiles for new models, deprecation banners, and pricing toggle screenshots. Deliverables must work across doc release notes, console release modal, and quickstart walkthroughs. Assets should include layered Figma file, export-ready PNGs (retina and standard), and a lightweight animated GIF showing pricing toggle behavior.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Hero tiles for 3 new models exported in light and dark theme (PNG@2x + SVG). 2) Pricing toggle screenshots showing 'dedicated vs hosted' and per-token/per-embed pricing states at 1365x768 and 1280x720. 3) Deprecation banner art and alt text for accessibility. 4) Files uploaded to Drive and linked in ticket. 5) Design review sign-off and PR with screenshots added to docs repo.
tasks: Audit existing model tile components in Figma and note mismatches with catalog styles
Design three new hero tile variants: compact, detailed, and badge-overlay
Create deprecation banner templates (short + extended copy) and alt text
Produce pricing toggle screenshots for two pricing tiers and three regions (US, EU, APAC) - static and GIF
Export assets: PNG@1x, PNG@2x, SVG, and a small GIF under 2MB
Upload final assets to Drive under /Design/ReleaseAssets/2026-03-catalog
Open docs PR adding screenshots to release-notes and quickstart pages
Gather accessibility review and localization copy variations
design_notes: Keep hero tiles consistent with new catalog grid spacing (8px baseline). Use tokenized colors from console theme: --catalog-bg, --accent-600. For new model badges, use concise capability labels (e.g., 'fast-generation', 'sparse-cache-optimized') and avoid long copy. Pricing toggles should show both per-token and effective per-request examples to help PMs and sales use screenshots in collateral.
tradeoffs: We debated a full animated walkthrough vs single GIF: animation length must be under 2MB for docs performance, so we chose short looped GIFs demonstrating toggle change only. Full video walkthrough will be a separate asset owned by Growth. Also considered grayscale deprecation banners for low-contrast environments but opted for color-accent to ensure discoverability.
